title: Elf Bar 600 Lemon Lime Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2PK
description: Made for the Elf Bar 600 Prefilled Pod Kit, these Lemon Lime pods deliver a sharp, citrus-led vape in a straightforward format. Each pack includes two 2ml pods preloaded with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, offering up to 600 puffs per pod depending on usage. Their inhale-activated design makes them easy to use with a smooth mouth-to-lung (MTL) draw and no buttons, refills, or coil changes to worry about. The flavour blends the tangy brightness of Lemon with the juicy zest of Lime, creating a lively and refreshing vape that tastes vivid from the first puff to the last. Once finished, swapping pods is clean and simple — just click in a new cartridge to keep vaping without interruption.
